heroHeadline: Drones Hit Moscow's Own Refinery — 40% of the Capital's Fuel — in Year's Largest Overnight Barrage
heroSubtitle: The Kapotnya refinery, which supplies 40% of Moscow city's fuel and 70% of regional petrol and aviation gas, was struck overnight as Ukraine launched its biggest drone assault of 2026, days after the Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl caught fire for the ninth time this year
